title: user-validation-designer output v0.1
description: Project-standard wrapper, field names and semantics identical to product-technical-audit. overall_judgment reuses that skill's exact four-value enum for cross-agent handoff; the user-side five-band verdict lives separately in user_value_judgment (DECISIONS D-02). Keyword set restricted to the shared validator subset: boolean constants use enum:[true].

result_summary.description: Conclusion first, <=200 chars. KB-USR-T01 section 0 shape: user value [band] + reason in <=40 chars.

weight.description: User-side weight set (DECISIONS D-03). Deliberately distinct from product-technical-audit's [15,20,25]; the two scoring systems answer different questions.

counted.description: false when the dimension has only <=E1 backing, per KB-USR-VS01. An uncounted dimension has score null and is excluded from counted_weight; it is NOT scored as low.

simulation_disclaimer.description: Program-injected fixed text. Every simulated product of this skill is capped at E2.

overall_judgment.description: PUBLIC cross-agent field. Enum copied verbatim from product-technical-audit/0.1/output so review_supervisor_agent consumes one vocabulary. Mapping from user_value_judgment: strong->strong, medium->medium, weak->weak, very_weak->weak, unverified->insufficient_evidence. On blocked/failed this is insufficient_evidence, never weak.

user_value_judgment.description: INTERNAL user-side five-band verdict, KB-USR-VS03 verbatim. >=80 and demand_strength>=4 -> strong; 65-79 medium; 50-64 weak; <50 very_weak; >=3 uncounted dimensions -> unverified; no E3+ evidence caps it at medium.

raw_total.description: Sum over counted dimensions of (score/5 x weight). Program-computed; a model-supplied total is discarded.

normalized_total.description: raw_total / counted_weight x 100, rounded to 2dp. All VS03 thresholds apply to THIS value (DECISIONS D-01). null when counted_weight is 0.

preliminary.description: true whenever no E3+ evidence exists. Report wording must say preliminary / E2.

scoring_note.description: Forbidden reading, restated for downstream: this total is an ordinal of demand-side evidence strength, not a like-ability or success probability (KB-USR-VS03).

clarification_questions.description: Populated when verdict is too_broad: who hurts most, who pays, who adopts first (KB-USR-R04).

outcome_metric.description: What cost is reduced or what result is obtained. Quantified preferred; a feature name is not an outcome (KB-USR-P02).

alternative_type.description: do_nothing must be considered explicitly: 'not solving it' is a real competitor (KB-USR-B01).

verdict.description: Program-decided: push+pull <= anxiety+habit -> will_not_switch, even when the product is objectively better (KB-USR-F02).

pseudo_demand_risk.description: No alternative found at all. If nobody is solving this today, the need may not exist (KB-USR-S2).

evidence_tier.description: Pinned. Simulation output can never be anything else.

first_experience.description: Forced to [] when S4a is not executable. Never inferred.

value_communication_failure.description: Program-set true when >=2 personas cannot restate the value claim. Then the top improvement must be copy/positioning, not features (KB-USR-S3).

task_test_matrix.description: Forced to [] when product_tasks is absent. Fabricating task results without a script is the single most damaging failure mode for this skill.

reason.description: Required when result=not_executed; explains why the required Persona x task pair could not be executed.

cognitive_walkthrough.description: Required on failed steps (KB-USR-F06 four questions).

cognitive_break_point.description: true when >=2 personas hesitate at the same step (KB-USR-F06).

simulated_interview.description: The only place verbatim-style prose is retained (KB-USR-T01 section 4). Downstream agents consume signals and insights, not the transcript.

strength.description: strong = past behaviour with a cost; weak = opinion or promise; politeness = vague praise, weight 0 (KB-USR-F07 / B02).

questions_raised.description: At least one genuine question per persona; a real user always has one (KB-USR-F07).

complaints.description: At least one concrete dissatisfaction per persona.

kano_type.description: reverse means remove or hide, not optimise (KB-USR-F05).

verdict.description: fail when either count is 0: a simulation with zero negatives is unrealistic and must be rerun (KB-USR-B02 / S5). not_applicable when no simulation ran at all.

linked_plan_ids.description: An open hypothesis must have a non-empty list here OR a non-empty deferred_reason (KB-USR-P01 item 4).

has_real_user_evidence.description: true only when at least one E3+ caller-supplied record is explicitly applicable to, and referenced by, a scored dimension. Unrelated E3+ evidence does not unlock the judgment.

expiry_unknown_refs.description: Evidence lacking expiry. Forwarded to evidence_calibration_agent; this skill assumes neither validity nor staleness (DECISIONS D-04).

resolution.description: Averaging is forbidden (KB-USR-B04). Persona-vs-persona conflicts are both_retained and surfaced to the supervisor as a key tension.

to_product_team_expert_agent.description: User-side phenomena and cognitive attribution only. Functional/technical attribution is theirs to decide; disagreement is retained as conflict.

to_investment_business_agent.description: Demand-side facts and evidence strength only. No market size, pricing or investment conclusions.

to_evidence_calibration_agent.description: Full evidence package for audit. On rejection this skill supplements or downgrades; it never argues to keep a verdict.

to_review_supervisor_agent.description: Dimension 'users and usage'. Explicitly excludes project-level recommendations.

regression_comparison.description: Present only in version_regression mode. See spec section 7.

progress_verdict.description: incomparable whenever the task baseline hash differs or the standard changed without a mapping. Last gate against moving the goalposts to manufacture progress.

outcome.description: not_executable means a required capability or input was absent. Such a step produces no evidence and no inferred result.
